text: dsh-im-hub-media 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的即时通讯网关，可将 Telegram、飞书（Feishu/Lark）和企业微信（WeCom）消息接入 DSH 智能体。插件把每个聊天映射为独立会话，转发文字、回复上下文和媒体输入，并将智能体答复发回聊天；Telegram 媒体支持语音转写、图片和文件，答复也可通过 MEDIA 标记发送文件。网页设置卡可配置适配器。适合希望从常用聊天应用与 DSH 智能体交流的用户。语音转写可选用 Deepgram 或 Hugging Face Whisper，并需相应密钥。

dsh-im-hub-media connects DSH Web with Telegram, Feishu, and WeCom. Each chat gets its own DSH agent session, and replies return to the chat. Telegram supports voice, photos, and files; MEDIA markers send files back. Optional voice transcription uses Deepgram or Hugging Face.
想从 Telegram 直接和 DSH 智能体聊天
让飞书里的消息进入 DSH 会话并收到回复
I want to send voice notes to my DSH agent and use their transcription as input
dsh-im-hub-media 的功能「聊天接入 DSH」：Telegram、飞书和企业微信收到的聊天消息可转交给对应 DSH 智能体会话，并把答复发回原聊天。每个聊天保留独立会话。
dsh-im-hub-media 的功能「Telegram 语音转文字」：收到语音或音频附件时，可将音频交给 Deepgram 转写，并在其未配置或不可用时尝试 Hugging Face Whisper；转写结果作为智能体输入。
dsh-im-hub-media 使用语音转写时，会把音频字节发送到 Deepgram；若配置 Hugging Face Whisper 备用项，也会向其推送音频。

@goodandready/dsh-im-hub-media README · ⚡ Overview：**`dsh-im-hub-media`** turns your **DeepSeek Harness** agents into 24/7 conversational assistants across **Telegram**, **Feishu (Lark)**, and **Enterprise WeChat (WeCom)** with automated speech-to-text voice transcription and bidirectional media exchange.

Unlike standard text-only bots, `dsh-im-hub-media` handles voice notes, photos, documents, and replies seamlessly, allowing agents to respond with rich media, synthesized audio, or files using native platform message formats.

@goodandready/dsh-im-hub-media README · 1. Telegram Adapter：* 🎙️ **Incoming Voice Transcription (STT)**: Voice notes (`.oga`/`.ogg`) are automatically intercepted, transcribed via host STT chains (e.g. `dsh-voice`), and injected as natural text.
* 🖼️ **Incoming Photos & Captions**: Photos are downloaded and passed directly to vision-capable models or through `dsh-vision-bridge`.
* 📄 **Document & File Handling**: Hermes-style extension filtering, configurable size caps, and small text/code file inline injection.
* 💬 **Quoted Replies & Thread Context**: Replying to a previous message preserves conversation history and context automatically.
* 📤 **Outbound Media Dispatch**: Agents emit `MEDIA:/absolute/path` markers in their reply; the plugin strips the marker and dispatches native `sendPhoto`, `sendVoice`, or `sendDocument` payloads.

@goodandready/dsh-im-hub-media README · 🔒 Security & Access Control：* **User & Chat Allowlists**: Restrict agent access using `allowedUsers` and `allowedChats` ID filters.
* **Session & Workspace Isolation**: Each chat maintains an independent session state, preventing context cross-talk.
* **Credentials Resolution**: Bot tokens (`TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `FEISHU_APP_SECRET`, etc.) are resolved via the host Credentials service.

@goodandready/dsh-im-hub-media README · 📦 Quick Installation：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @goodandready/dsh-im-hub-media
```

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Restart DSH after installation (`systemctl --user restart dsh-web`) to mount the IM hub adapter tree.
